description: Other Qwen3-14B LoRA fine-tunes trained by the author with the same recipe as the reported adapter (r=32, alpha=64, lr 1e-4, 3 epochs, seed 42, lowest-validation-loss checkpoint) and evaluated on ReasonIF with the same settings (temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, 16,384 new tokens, seed 42 + question index, official prompts with the Qwen3-14B word-limit key). Training data are described from the LlamaFactory configs on the training VM and the author's notes (2026-10-11). Each was trained and evaluated once. Records: results/reasonif_300/qwen3_14b_training_variants/<folder>/scored_responses.jsonl.
